title: Assistant Manager (Grade A)
qualification: B.Tech/ B.E, LLB, CA, MBA/ PGDM
age_limit: Assistant Manager (Grade A):21 to 30 years as on 28 February 2026 (candidate must have attained 21 years and must not have attained 30 years). || Manager (Grade B):Upper age limit 40 years as on 28 February 2026 (candidate must not have attained 40 years). || Relaxations in upper age limit for SC, ST, OBC (NCL), EWS, PwBD, Ex‑Servicemen and children/family members of 1984 riots victims are applicable as per Government of India rules.
application_fee: For UR / OBC / EWS & other categories: ₹600 total (₹500 examination fee + ₹100 intimation charges). || For SC / ST / PwBD candidates: ₹100 total (intimation charges only, no examination fee). || The fee must be paid online during the application process through the official IIFCL website iifcl.in within the registration window from 18 March 2026 to 10 April 2026.
selection_process: The IIFCL Grade A & Grade B Selection Process 2026 is identical for both posts and consists of two phases – an online examination followed by a technical and behavioural interview. || Phase I – Online Examination:Objective type, 200 marks, with two tests – Test I (Reasoning, Quantitative Aptitude, English Language, Current Affairs related to Financial Sector – 100 marks) and Test II (Domain Knowledge – 100 marks). Total 150 questions, 120 minutes with sectional time limits, and negative marking of 1/4th of the marks for each wrong answer. || Phase II – Interview:Candidates shortlisted based on Phase I performance will be called for an interview of 100 marks, which may be conducted in Hindi or English at IIFCL’s office in New Delhi. || Final Merit List:Prepared by combining marks of Online Examination (Phase I) and Interview (Phase II) with a weightage of 40:60 respectively; candidates must qualify both stages and rank sufficiently high in merit to be selected. || IIFCL may additionally conduct Group Discussion, psychometric tests or other assessment tools, and reserves the right to change the selection procedure or exam structure as notified on its website.
